title: 10 MORE Things I Wish I Knew Before Starting Dragonwilds
author: Spopes
chapters: 4.) Collect Sanguine Urns for More HP
9.) Looting Goblin & Garou Packs for Rare Runes
BONUS: Dedicated Servers Can Have up to 6 Players
description:
One thing any RuneScape Dragonwilds player will tell you is there’s always more to learn. As a follow-up to my original tips video, we’re about to cover the next 10 most important things you need to know as you embark on your Dragonwilds journey — from the best armor set combo to how to escape and evade enemies with ease, let’s get into 10 more tips I wish I knew before I started playing.

If you missed the first 10 essential beginner tips, make sure to watch that video here: https://youtu.be/J7UxNjpGGGk

Timestamps:
00:00 - Intro (Dragonwilds Tips)
00:27 - 1.) Delete in Repair Mode
01:15 - 2.) Start Farming Early
02:39 - 3.) First Lodestone in Fractured Plains
03:49 - 4.) Collect Sanguine Urns for More HP
04:51 - 5.) Mage & Melee Armor Combo
05:49 - 6.) Matching Enemy Weaknesses
06:43 - 7.) Using Evasive Magic
07:31 - 8.) Running Away from Enemies
08:10 - 9.) Looting Goblin & Garou Packs for Rare Runes
08:45 - 10.) Runecrafting Minigame
09:45 - BONUS: Dedicated Servers Can Have up to 6 Players
10:25 - Comment
11:14 - Prayer
11:45 - Outro
